thread:
oliver: Heads-up — after the RBAC tweak to `service-account-internal` yesterday I noticed KMS audit events stopped for three staging services (ingest, preview, eval). Not sure if the change removed the audit role. anyone made that change?
maria: I pushed the role update to remove broad `kms.admin` perms and scoped to encrypt/decrypt only. did not touch audit bindings.
kevin: @maria can you paste the terraform change? quick diff helps.
maria: sure — diff: ```- google_project_iam_binding "kms-admin" { role = "roles/cloudkms.admin" members = [...] } + google_project_iam_binding "kms-usage" { role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter" members = [...] }```
samira: hmm that looks fine. audit logging should be independent but if a binding on the audit-log SA was removed it could drop events. oliver which services?
oliver: ingest-stg, preview-stg, eval-worker-stg. checking Stackdriver: last KMS audit for ingest-stg was 2024-11-12T03:14Z then silence.
sec-bot: [ALERT] Missing KMS audit entries for projects/redwood-staging on resources/cryptoKeys/* — threshold breached (30m).
kevin: can we confirm if organization-level audit config got changed? maybe a `gcloud` command removed the log type.
james: I ran `gcloud logging sinks list --project=redwood-staging` earlier, no sink deletions. but audit config is separate: `gcloud logging logs describe` not relevant.
ompet: (typo) ignore
maria: pinging infra to check auditConfigs in IAM policy.
eng-oncall: I'm on it, will run a policy dump and `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-staging --format=json` now.
eng-oncall: dump shows `auditConfigs` present for `cloudkms.googleapis.com` but `exemptedMembers` includes `serviceAccount:service-account-internal@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com` — that would suppress logs.
kevin: ahhhh that explains it — an exemptedMember was added during the role change. who approved that?
maria: I remember adding a temporary exemption for lambda-style tests then forgot to remove. my bad.
oliver: ok can we remove the exemption and backfill? need to know if we lost anything critical.
eng-oncall: removal steps: ```gcloud projects set-iam-policy redwood-staging policy.json``` — update `auditConfigs` to remove the exemptedMembers entry, then `gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_container AND protoPayload.serviceName=cloudkms.googleapis.com" --project=redwood-staging --limit=10` to validate.
devops-bot: scheduled change: remove audit exemption @maria -> ETA 10m (requires owner approval).
kevin: before we do that — any chance a DAST scan surfaced an endpoint that uses a KMS key incorrectly? we had a canary DAST finding last night about an exposed metrics endpoint that returns base64 blobs.
samira: I correlate DAST finding id D-20241111-33 with eval-worker-stg. the trace shows a non-authenticated `/metrics/raw` endpoint accessible from preview-stg. likely separate but could leak ciphertext metadata.
james: SAST side: I just triaged two new findings flagged by CodeScan: `hardcoded-kms-key-id` in `pkg/ingest/encryption.go` — low severity but flagged because tests use the staging key id in testdata.
oliver: ok so action items: (1) remove the exemptedMember from auditConfigs (maria + infra), (2) run `gcloud logging read` to confirm events flow, (3) rotate any test/staging keys if they were embedded in source or fixtures, (4) triage DAST endpoint and lock it behind auth, (5) document the accidental exemption in the incident ticket.
maria: starting PR to remove exemption, tagging @kevin for review. PR description includes rollback plan.
sec-bot: [NOTICE] Incident created: INC-2024-11012 — "staging KMS audit gap" assigned to eng-oncall, severity P2.
eng-oncall: applied policy change. running quick check... `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign\"" --project=redwood-staging --limit=5` returned new entries from ingest-stg.
oliver: looks like logs resumed. thanks. can we confirm retention/backfill possibility?
james: logs are not backfillable in Cloud Logging if they were never produced. we can only show new events. create a timeline of actions to show potential exposure window.
kevin: for compliance, we should treat window 2024-11-12T03:14Z -> 2024-11-12T03:58Z as missing and assume worst-case. rotate any staging keys used by tests to be safe.
samira: I'll open DAST follow-up ticket and assign to preview/ingest owners. also adding an eval for SAST test fixtures to avoid hardcoded key ids.
maria: PR merged to remove exemption. created a postmortem draft in docs/incidents/INC-2024-11012.md — will add timeline and owner notes.
oliver: thanks everyone. small checklist: rotate staging key, disable `/metrics/raw` or auth it, add CI check to reject `TEST_KEY_ID` literals, and add a policy review step to RBAC changes (explicit auditConfig check).
eng-oncall: adding RBAC change checklist item to the PR template and `security-alert` webhook to run a quick `gcloud` auditConfig check on apply.
sec-bot: [CLOSE] Incident INC-2024-11012 moved to monitoring after remediation steps completed. :white_check_mark:
maria: sorry again — will add a step to the changelog and comms.
oliver: good runbook input. will follow up on postmortem w/ SLO impact and compliance notes.
kevin: thanks team. small reminder — if anyone touches `auditConfigs` add a second owner approval. :+1:
